note: The RAR5 owner extra field's user-name length is decoded from input into value_len; the candidate encodes this length as 256.
The boundary check only truncates lengths greater than OWNER_MAXNAMELEN, so an input length equal to OWNER_MAXNAMELEN is allowed even though a trailing NUL will also be written.
Because value_len equals OWNER_MAXNAMELEN and does not satisfy the greater-than guard, name_len is set to 256.
The input-controlled 256-byte user name fills the 256-byte stack buffer exactly, leaving no element for a terminator.
With name_len equal to OWNER_MAXNAMELEN, this writes index 256 of char namebuf[OWNER_MAXNAMELEN], producing the UBSan index-out-of-bounds condition.
